data.content: ["Matagorda offers excellent free beach outdoor activities and budget-friendly accommodations, perfectly matching your group's desire for cheap weekend fun with minimal spending.", "Albuquerque combines affordable low-cost lodging with abundant free outdoor exploration and diverse simple food options that won't strain your minimal budget.", "Las Cruces delivers the cheapest realistic weekend option with free outdoor desert activities and walkable low-cost dining, ideal for maximizing your tight budget.", "Tucson provides low-cost hotel rates with excellent free outdoor activities in desert parks and affordable local food scenes perfect for budget-conscious travelers.", "Surfside Beach offers the most affordable beach destination with free coastal outdoor activities and walkable access to simple, inexpensive food options for a budget weekend getaway."]
